apriltags.hint: 150 mm tags (tag36h11). Print at 100 % and measure the check distance. At least 3 tags per project are recommended.

apriltags.warning_no_control: Only {count} AprilTag(s) found – no check possible
apriltags.warning_georef_unavailable: Fewer than 3 surveyed AprilTags – scale only
